feature: HLA-restricted immunotherapy handles (HA-1/HA-2 TCR-T, WT1, PRAME) - the primary reason for this Libby run
test_name: High-resolution HLA class I typing (HLA-A allele level; report A*02:01 and A*24:02)
tissue_type: Archived 2020 typing report; if unavailable, EDTA whole blood or buccal swab
rationale: Resolves HLA-A*02:01 status, the master switch for the HLA-restricted immunotherapy axis that motivated this case: HA-1/HA-2 TCR-T (TSC-100/TSC-101), WT1, and PRAME approaches are all A*02:01-restricted. Parallel A*24:02 typing preserves a WT1-siTCR option if A*02:01 is negative. The 2020 allele-level result is only a placeholder in the chart, so retrieval or repeat high-resolution typing gates the entire pathway before any of these interventions can be scoped.
turnaround_estimate: Records retrieval same-day; repeat high-resolution typing 3-7 days
tissue_required_estimate: Pull the archived 2020 high-resolution typing from the transplant/donor-registry file; if not retrievable, 5-10 mL EDTA (lavender-top) whole blood or a buccal swab
decision_gated: HA-1/HA-2 TCR-T (TSC-100/TSC-101 via NCT05473910) plus WT1- and PRAME-directed A*02:01-restricted immunotherapy; A*24:02 opens a WT1-siTCR alternative.

feature: HLA-restricted immunotherapy handles (HA-1/HA-2 TCR-T, WT1, PRAME) - the primary reason for this Libby run
test_name: HA-1 / HA-2 minor histocompatibility antigen genotyping of recipient AND HLA-identical sibling donor
tissue_type: Recipient and donor whole blood / buccal DNA
rationale: HA-directed TCR-T requires a specific mismatch, recipient HA-1(H)-positive and donor HA-1-negative, and HLA-identical siblings can still differ at HA-1/HA-2. Genotyping both the patient and the sibling donor establishes whether TSC-100 (HA-1) or TSC-101 (HA-2) eligibility exists; the approach is additionally gated on HLA-A*02:01. Skipping the donor arm leaves eligibility indeterminate even when the patient genotype is favorable.
turnaround_estimate: 1-2 weeks (single-SNP genotype; longer if routed through a trial central lab)
tissue_required_estimate: 5-10 mL EDTA (lavender-top) whole blood from the patient and a paired sample from the sibling donor (buccal swab acceptable for the SNP genotype)
decision_gated: TSC-100 (HA-1) / TSC-101 (HA-2) donor-derived TCR-T via NCT05473910; requires recipient-positive / donor-negative mHAg mismatch.

providers.notes: HA-1/HA-2 genotyping is not a routine commercial catalog test; the most reliable route to a decision-grade result is the ALLOHA (NCT05473910) sponsor central lab, which performs recipient and donor genotyping as part of eligibility screening.

test_name: Comprehensive relapse myeloid NGS panel with variant-level TP53 readout, low-VAF sensitivity, and copy-number detection
tissue_type: Relapse bone marrow aspirate or peripheral blood; archival 2019 material for comparison
rationale: A relapse myeloid NGS panel with variant-level readout, adequate low-VAF sensitivity, and copy-number detection resolves the specific TP53 amino-acid change and reconciles the 2019-pathogenic versus 2026-negative discrepancy without down-calling on a 2%-LOD/no-CNV assay. A confirmed Y220C opens the Y220C-selective reactivator rezatapopt (PC14586); a non-Y220C aberration would not, and eprenetapopt is low-yield. The same panel re-interrogates FLT3, IDH1, and IDH2 at relapse given documented clonal evolution.
tissue_required_estimate: Relapse bone marrow aspirate (EDTA/heparin) or peripheral blood at current high blast burden; retrieve archived 2019 fixed-cell pellet or extracted DNA for side-by-side comparison
decision_gated: Rezatapopt (PC14586) via PYNNACLE (NCT04585750) if Y220C-positive; also re-tests FLT3/IDH1/IDH2 at relapse.

test_name: TP53 (17p13) FISH for deletion / copy loss
tissue_type: Bone marrow aspirate (fresh) or archival fixed-cell pellet
rationale: TP53 (17p13) FISH detects allelic copy loss and 17p deletion that the 2026 relapse panel could not see because it lacked copy-number detection, which is central to reconciling the discrepancy without assuming reversion to wild-type. Biallelic (multi-hit) TP53 status refines both prognosis and the strength of the TP53-aberrant call. Omitting it risks mis-classifying a copy-loss-driven aberration as absent.
tissue_required_estimate: Bone marrow aspirate (fresh, sodium heparin) or an archival fixed-cell pellet / marrow smears from the relapse workup
decision_gated: Confirms TP53-aberrant (17p loss / biallelic) call underpinning prognosis and rezatapopt candidacy workup.

test_name: p53 protein immunohistochemistry on marrow biopsy (clone DO-7)
tissue_type: FFPE bone marrow trephine / clot section (archival acceptable)
rationale: Strong or aberrant (null-pattern) p53 expression by immunohistochemistry on the marrow biopsy is a protein-level correlate of TP53 mutation and multi-hit status in myeloid neoplasms (Saft 2014; Cleven 2015). A positive pattern supports the TP53-aberrant working call independent of the NGS discrepancy, whereas a clean wild-type pattern would prompt scrutiny of the 2019 result. It does not establish the Y220C variant, so it complements rather than replaces variant-level NGS.
tissue_required_estimate: FFPE bone marrow trephine core biopsy or clot section; archival material from the relapse marrow is acceptable
decision_gated: Confirms TP53-aberrant target call at the protein level; does not establish Y220C (NGS required).

test_name: Retrieval of the 2019 diagnostic NGS report (TP53 variant identity + VAF)
tissue_type: No new specimen; original report and, if needed, archived 2019 DNA/pellet
rationale: Retrieving the original 2019 diagnostic report gives the exact TP53 variant identity and VAF that anchor the reconciliation; a founder mutation shared with the 2019 clone would argue the 2026 negative reflects subclonal loss or assay limitation rather than true reversion. Whether that variant is Y220C directly determines rezatapopt candidacy. Without the original identity the discrepancy cannot be adjudicated and the therapy handle stays undefined.
tissue_required_estimate: No new specimen; obtain the 2019 diagnostic NGS report and, if re-testing is needed, the archived 2019 fixed-cell pellet or extracted DNA from the originating laboratory
decision_gated: Anchors TP53 discrepancy reconciliation and the Y220C determination that gates rezatapopt.
notes: This is a records/archived-material retrieval from the 2019 originating laboratory rather than a catalog assay; the lab is named in the 2019 pathology report.

test_name: STR chimerism on FACS-sorted CD34+ blasts with side-by-side 2019-vs-2026 cytogenetic comparison
tissue_type: Relapse marrow with CD34+ sorting; recipient and donor reference DNA
rationale: STR chimerism on FACS-sorted CD34+ blasts, read alongside a side-by-side 2019-versus-2026 cytogenetic comparison, confirms whether the relapse is recipient-derived evolution of the original clone or a donor-derived leukemia (the sex-matched sibling donor precludes XY-FISH). Recipient origin is a prerequisite for HA-directed TCR-T, which targets recipient-restricted minor histocompatibility antigens, and it shapes DLI and second-transplant strategy. A donor-derived leukemia would redirect the entire plan.
tissue_required_estimate: Relapse bone marrow with CD34+ cell sorting, plus paired recipient (pre-transplant or buccal) DNA and donor reference DNA
decision_gated: Recipient-origin relapse is a prerequisite for HA-directed TCR-T and steers DLI / HCT2 strategy.

test_name: Quantitative CD33 antigen-density flow cytometry (antibodies bound per cell)
tissue_type: Fresh viable marrow or peripheral blood
rationale: Quantitative CD33 antigen density (antibodies-bound-per-cell) upgrades the current qualitative-positive flow to the metric that predicts benefit from the CD33 ADC gemtuzumab ozogamicin; higher blast CD33 expression correlates with greater gemtuzumab effect (Olombel 2016). Density also informs dual CD33/CD123 targeting. Qualitative positivity alone does not establish whether ADC-level expression is present.
tissue_required_estimate: Fresh (viable) bone marrow aspirate or peripheral blood in EDTA/heparin, delivered within 24-48 h for antigen-density quantitation
decision_gated: Gemtuzumab ozogamicin (CD33 ADC) candidacy; informs dual CD33/CD123 targeting.

test_name: Quantitative CD123 antigen-density flow cytometry (antibodies bound per cell)
tissue_type: Fresh viable marrow or peripheral blood
rationale: Quantitative CD123 antigen density converts the qualitative-positive call into the expression metric that guides CD123-directed selection: tagraxofusp (CD123 immunotoxin; Pemmaraju 2019) and pivekimab sunirine (CD123 ADC; Daver 2024). Density supports agent choice and dual CD33/CD123 cytoreduction ahead of a cellular or transplant consolidation. A density readout de-risks committing to a CD123 agent on qualitative positivity alone.
tissue_required_estimate: Fresh (viable) bone marrow aspirate or peripheral blood in EDTA/heparin, delivered within 24-48 h for antigen-density quantitation
decision_gated: Tagraxofusp / pivekimab sunirine (CD123-directed) selection and dual CD33/CD123 cytoreduction.

test_name: Full metaphase karyotype (conventional cytogenetics) at relapse
tissue_type: Fresh bone marrow aspirate for metaphase culture
rationale: A full metaphase karyotype at relapse completes the FISH-based 2026 picture and characterizes the adverse MECOM rearrangement and KMT2A amplification that shape prognosis and trial eligibility. Complete cytogenetics is required by most AML risk models and trial protocols and supports the side-by-side clonal-evolution comparison. FISH panels alone can miss balanced rearrangements and additional subclones.
tissue_required_estimate: Fresh bone marrow aspirate in sodium heparin (green-top) for metaphase culture
decision_gated: AML risk stratification and trial-eligibility cytogenetics; supports clonal-evolution comparison.

test_name: Right-thigh contrast MRI plus whole-body FDG-PET/CT for extramedullary disease mapping
rationale: Contrast MRI of the right thigh plus whole-body FDG-PET/CT maps the extent of the extramedullary myeloid sarcoma, an adverse feature, and shows whether directed radiotherapy is warranted before or bridging to a second transplant. Extramedullary burden also affects conditioning choice (for example targeted radioimmunotherapy) and response assessment. Leaving it unmapped risks under-treating a sanctuary site that drives relapse.
tissue_required_estimate: No tissue required; contrast-enhanced MRI of the right thigh and whole-body FDG-PET/CT
decision_gated: Directed-RT decision and extramedullary disease mapping ahead of HCT2 / conditioning choice.
notes: Performed by the treating institution's radiology and nuclear-medicine services rather than a reference laboratory.
